backend/main.mo: Actor backend storing inquiries in memory and providing functions to submit and retrieve them.
feature_evidence.json: Structured report mapping implemented features to related files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling defining CSS variables, dark mode tokens, and base element styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading fonts and mounting the React application root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with the app's main routes wrapped in the SiteLayout component.
frontend/src/components/CategoryHierarch: Component rendering subcategory cards that navigate to their respective subcategory routes.
frontend/src/components/ProductQuickView: Modal for product quick‑view with scroll lock, backdrop blur, close interactions, and responsive image/content layout.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer component displaying company info, quick links, contact details, and branding with dynamic year.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation links, and mobile menu using router state to highlight active paths.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper that renders header, footer, and routed page content via Outlet.
Card component generating product descriptions and placeholder images based on category and subcategory.
frontend/src/data/productTaxonomy.ts: Defines product category taxonomy including categories, subcategories, and product types with associated metadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing backend actor instances tied to Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and auth-client lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Hook providing mutation for submitting inquiries through the backend actor and refreshing related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme color variables, base styles, component utilities, and custom animations for the UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, configuring React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders a detailed About Us page describing the company, mission, and differentiators.
frontend/src/pages/CataloguePage.tsx: Displays product catalogue details and features, with a button to request a catalogue via the contact page.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Shows a product category page with banner, navigation, customization note, and subcategory hierarchy.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, category prefill, and submission handling through a query hook.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Builds the homepage with hero, introduction, and highlights sections, linking to products and catalogue.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Renders a products overview page displaying categories as clickable cards that navigate to their subcategory listings.
frontend/src/pages/SubcategoryPage.tsx: Displays products for a selected subcategory with navigation, inquiry actions, and product quick‑view modal handling.
frontend/src/utils/slug.ts: Provides utility functions to convert text to URL-friendly slugs and back.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Describes project state and requirements focused on implementing a premium product quick‑view modal on subcategory pages.
